name: PrimalMyst Armor Type Reference
description: Standard armor, evasion, and energy shield assignments keep familiar RPG defenses while aligning with our hexagonal structure.
interaction_notes: Armor types do not interact with elemental or raw physical categories; they will interface with explicit damage types defined later.
source_rules: All armor ratings originate from equipped gear; no base stats or passives provide these values.

rating_rules.notes: Paths to exceed 75% up to 90% will be defined separately
